issues.description: When Stripe times out the payment service retries the charge. Some customers were charged twice. Use an idempotency key per order.

issues.summary: JWT access token expiry too short
issues.description: Users are logged out after 15 minutes. Increase the access token expiry or add a refresh flow.
Celery worker queue backlog delays confirmation emails by up to an hour when the mailer is unavailable.

issues.summary: Stock not released when orders are cancelled
issues.description: Cancelling an order leaves stock reserved in Redis. release_stock must run on cancellation.

issues.summary: Migrate orders database to RDS Postgres 15
issues.description: Move the orders Postgres database to AWS RDS engine version 15 using Terraform.

issues.summary: Add rate limiting to the public API
issues.description: Limit requests per client IP to protect the API. Return HTTP 429 when the limit is exceeded.
The refund service always refunds the full amount. Partial refund amounts are ignored.

issues.summary: Stripe webhook signature verification fails after key rotation
issues.description: After rotating the webhook secret, webhook events are rejected because the signature check uses the old secret.
Applying a discount code twice reduces the order total twice. Track whether a discount was already applied.

issues.summary: Product catalog cache is stale after updates
issues.description: The catalog is cached in Redis for 5 minutes. Invalidate the cache when products change.
Upgrade the runtime and CI images to Python 3.12.
New joiners report the onboarding guide references old tools.
